name: Swisttal (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, yellow and white in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the top with the municipal arms of Swisttal (a black cross on white beside a chequy field).
history: Municipal flag of Swisttal; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
